design: ABBA per-projection (252 calls per microbatch) versus per-layer (36). Same seven Qwen projection shapes per layer, identical floating-point loss assembly, BF16, original native-rank row counts, dropout and four-microbatch DDP. Both preserve RNG and enable early stop. Each group compares full first two parameter, gradient and optimizer moment vectors against the baseline. Capture rank-max end-to-end latency, peak bytes and checkpoint invocation counts.
rationale: The original checkpoint early-stop pair showed median duration +0.68%, no steady peak difference and low driver activity (47.6–51.4%). Reduce checkpoint invocation overhead at existing layer boundaries while holding dropout and projection order.
resource_policy: Keep original GLM protected nodes, the two external KFD nodes and original unknown MiniCPM reservations. Equal source and resources for both arms. 72 GiB host/node; each node gates PCI and KFD before device use.
formal_qualification: Component-only generated activations. The per-layer graph contains LoRA projections rather than a full decoder. No model drift, full model performance or A100 claims.
original_grouped_behavior: Use the matched no-promotion result as motivation. No duplicate invocation of either original pairing.
